title: ImmuneCharge++
description: ImmuneCharge++ makes wind charges and wind burst explosions ignore knockback resistance — just like Blast Protection armor enchantments do. Perfect for balanced PvP and survival gameplay on servers and singleplayer
body: ImmuneCharge++ is a simple Fabric mod that makes wind charge explosions ignore knockback resistance. Players and mobs with knockback resistance will still be knocked back by wind charges, making wind charges more consistent and reliable in combat.
